patient_actor_hidden.History: The patient reports a skin lesion on her right leg that has been present for 1 month. The lesion began as a small red spot and has increased in size. She recalls an ant bite at the site before the lesion developed. She has a history of anterior uveitis treated with corticosteroids 8 months ago, as well as Crohn's disease, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypertension.

Symptoms.Primary_Symptom: Painful ulcerative lesion on the right leg
Secondary_Symptoms: Lesion has a central necrotic base and purplish irregular borders
History of ant bite at the site of the lesion
Pitting pedal edema of the lower extremities
Dilated tortuous veins in both lower legs

Past_Medical_History: Treated for anterior uveitis 8 months ago
patient_actor_hidden.Social_History: Recently returned from a visit to Wisconsin 2 months ago.

objective_for_doctor: Evaluate and diagnose the patient presenting with a painful, ulcerative skin lesion on her leg.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: Doctor: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on? Patient: I have a painful ulcerative lesion on my right leg that started as a small red spot about a month ago and has been getting larger. I remember an ant bite right at the spot before it developed, and it now has a central necrotic area with purplish, irregular borders.

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—like twitching, jerking, shaking, or sudden uncontrollable movements of your face, arms, legs, or hands? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t noticed any involuntary twitching, jerking, or sudden uncontrollable movements. I’ve mostly just had the painful ulcerative lesion on my right leg and the swelling in my lower legs.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** and feels like it **moves or shifts** when you touch it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump in my right breast or anything that moves or shifts when I touch it.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently tap around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, when I press around my belly button area it doesn’t feel tender or painful.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been vomiting recently (yes or no)?
Have you noticed a lump or mass in your **right breast** (for example, a new or growing area you can feel)?
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast, or any new or growing area I can feel. It hasn’t been painful either.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that the lenses in **both** of your eyes look **cloudy or hazy**, making your vision seem less clear? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed my vision looking cloudy or hazy in either eye, and my sight seems about the same as before.”

turns.doctor_question: In the past 6 to 12 months, have you lost weight without trying (for example, your clothes feel looser or the scale went down), even though you didn’t change your diet or exercise?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t lost weight without trying in the past 6 to 12 months—I think my weight has been about the same.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump or mass in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** (painless), even if it’s small?
turns.patient_answer: “No—I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast, even if it doesn’t hurt or is small. I haven’t had any new breast changes that I can feel.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been pregnant recently, or is there any chance you might be pregnant right now?
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t been pregnant and there’s no chance I could be pregnant right now.”
